text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered -> service=redwood-prod-ingest, alert=ingest-queue-latency, incident=PDI-321. Routing shows schedule=prod-weekday -> pages sent to 'oncall-sre-legacy' at 2023-11-05T23:14:03Z. Suspect schedule binding mismatch.

jamal: I just got the page but I'm on infra-oncall rotation for tonight. I think PD binding points to the old oncall-sre schedule.

nicole: I can confirm PDI-321 went to oncall-sre-legacy. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PDI-321 (placeholder). No infra-oncall recipients listed.

matt: Can someone ack and escalate to infra-oncall? I'm pulling logs now.

sara: I'll do a manual page to infra and check the service bindings. One sec.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PDI-321 acknowledged by jamal.

jamal: Ack. Jumping in. Quick triage: ingest queue latency spiked ~23:14, a bunch of clients got 502s for ~3-7 minutes.

nicole: Are we sure it's a wrong binding vs a schedule override? Checking the service -> escalation policy binding now.

matt: Output from pd-cli: ```
# pd-cli schedule get SCHED_123
name: prod-weekday
bindings:
  - oncall-sre-legacy
  - rota: night
# expected binding: infra-oncall
```

sara: Yeah that bindings block is wrong. It should point at infra-oncall escalation policy (infra-ep-2). I can update the service routing to infra-ep-2 which will forward all active pages. Will do a manual re-route.

sara: Running manual update: ```
# pd-cli service update --service-id SVC_INGEST --escalation-policy infra-ep-2
=> OK
# then trigger reroute/page
pd-cli incident notify --incident PDI-321 --to-service infra-oncall
```

incident-bot: Manual re-route performed by sara. PagerDuty: new page sent to infra-oncall.

sara: Manual page delivered. Asking infra to ack.

oncall-rotation: infra-oncall acknowledged by @matt.

matt: I'm taking IC. Quick customer impact summary: approx 800 ingestion requests failed between 23:14:03 and 23:19:40 UTC in us-east-1. Most retried and succeeded; some clients saw errors logged. No data confirmed lost yet, but need to verify dedupe/retry windows. Marking sev2 for now.

jamal: Mitigations applied: scaled ingest-workers + restarted ingest-processor on two nodes. KV-cache warmed, consumer lag recovered. CPU on ingest pods peaked then returned to normal.

nicole: From PD config side: found automation that syncs schedules from org-tool but it didn't pick up schedule rename last month. That automation still references the old schedule id.

matt: Good catch. For immediate action we re-pointed service -> infra-ep-2 manually. Long-term we need to fix the sync job and add unit test coverage.

sara: Quick log snippet (truncated):
```
2023-11-05T23:14:07Z ERROR ingest: queue latency=1200ms drop=12 id=txn_abc123
2023-11-05T23:14:09Z WARN  k8s: pod ingest-processor-5 OOM? restarted
```

jamal: Customer impact estimate: ~0.8% of ingestion volume for the 5-minute window in east region. Affected customers: 3 known customers reported spikes, support ticket triage underway.

nicole: I've opened follow-up tickets: PD config bug (PD-524), automation fix (ENGOPS-998), runbook update (DOCS-342).

matt: Creating incident record in tracker: INC-2023-568. Assigning postmortem owners: jamal (remediation), nicole (PD config + automation), sara (runbook + deploy test), matt (postmortem lead).

sara: Action items while hot: 1) keep manual routing monitoring for 30m, 2) verify no further pages routed to oncall-sre-legacy, 3) rollback manual change only after automation is fixed.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note appended to PDI-321: "Service routing updated to infra-ep-2 by sara. Manual page sent. Investigating config sync with automation."

jamal: Thanks team. I'll collect logs and customer error samples and drop them into the incident doc.

matt: We'll run a short blameless postmortem. Initial timeline and evidence collection in INC-2023-568. Expect a postmortem draft tomorrow EOD.

nicole: Post-incident: added a CI job to validate schedule IDs during config deploy (PR coming). Also adding an alert if a service receives pages but has zero recipients in expected escalation policy.

sara: :thumbsup: Good work. Closing the live thread. If anything else fires, ping this thread.

incident-bot: Incident PDI-321 transitioned to "under investigation".

matt: Closing note: no further customer escalations as of 00:10 UTC. Will reconvene for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
